metrics.name: Prototype functionality coverage
metrics.formula: 100 * sum(weights of passed acceptance scenarios) / sum(weights of all frozen acceptance scenarios)
metrics.method: Freeze scenarios and weights before coding: critical=3, supporting=1. A scenario passes only with executed evidence. Code line coverage is not functionality coverage.

metrics.name: User flow completion rate
metrics.target: 100% automated critical journeys; >=90% human task attempts
metrics.method: Separate automated completion from human usability; use 5 predefined tasks and record success without facilitator rescue.

metrics.name: Error recovery success rate
metrics.formula: 100 * faults recovered correctly / injected fault scenarios
metrics.method: Require preserved committed data, no duplicate effect and a clear next action. Report omitted/non-applicable scenarios explicitly.

metrics.name: Website information architecture clarity
metrics.formula: 100 * tasks found correctly within 30 seconds without hints / all findability tasks
metrics.method: Five prompts: identify problem/status, find demo/status, find evidence, find technical approach and find responsible team member. Log each response and time; report small-sample uncertainty.

metrics.name: Slide narrative coherence index
metrics.method: Three reviewers independently score problem clarity, evidence, problem-solution link, architecture/demo linkage, feasibility and closing. 0=missing, 1=contradictory, 2=present but weak, 3=clear, 4=clear with evidence and transitions. Preserve individual ratings.

metrics.name: Judge readiness proxy
metrics.formula: 100 * mean(problem relevance, differentiation, feasibility, demonstrability, impact evidence, delivery clarity ratings) / 4
metrics.method: Use anchored 0–4 rubric as a preparation score only. Score after verified domain and working demo. It is not an official SIH score or a calibrated prediction.

metrics.name: Judge persuasion probability
metrics.formula: Not defined until outcome-labeled historical data and held-out calibration exist
metrics.target: No target; must remain null without calibration
metrics.method: Fit and validate only on comparable labeled judging outcomes; disclose sample, selection bias, reliability curve and Brier score. Do not map readiness score to a probability.

metrics.name: Core flow p95 latency
metrics.formula: Nearest-rank p95 of elapsed action-to-usable-result durations for each flow
metrics.method: Record browser event start, render completion, environment and samples. Keep API, UI, cold-start and internet latency distinct.

metrics.name: Website Lighthouse scores
metrics.formula: Median of 3 raw category scores * 100 per device profile
metrics.target: >90 in all four categories on mobile and desktop
metrics.method: Production build, clean browser profile, exact URL, Chrome/Lighthouse versions and config. Store each JSON report, not only summary.

metrics.name: Concurrent prototype reliability
metrics.method: 20 sessions/1000 synthetic records for 5 minutes; classify expected validation errors separately before run.

metrics.name: Social impact outcome
metrics.formula: Pending verified problem and impact model
metrics.target: Baseline and target must be explicit; no measured value yet
metrics.method: Specify beneficiary, counterfactual, denominator, observation period and uncertainty. Track adoption, outcome and harms separately.

interpretation: Targets are self-imposed preparation criteria, not official SIH evaluation weights. Null means no measurement, never zero. Readiness score is not judge persuasion probability. B07 remains null unless a defensible calibration study is supplied; its null state is expected, not a permission to invent a probability.
